description: O11 (data lot, phase 3): REFACTOR of the entity model over job:spec-data (Contact with FK StatusId to the static Status and the aggregate Contact_CountActive whose filter cites the FK). (1) RE-POINT a common attribute with a consumer: Email -> Mail (replace rewires the filter created here; the source is left with 0 consumers and is deleted without force). (2) RE-POINT an FK: StatusId -> StatusId2; the platform gives each FK an AutoIndex and the replace drags the old attribute's one to the new one, which ends up with two equal indexes (InvalidEntityIndex_DupIndexes): the proven path is to delete the old AutoIndex and only then the old FK (without force). (3) CHANGE THE TYPE of an FK: with a DefaultValue the kernel refuses (tests/jobs-negative/fk-type-change-with-default.json); clearing the DefaultValue first lets the change pass and Verify stays clean -- it runs headless, it does not prove data migration. (4) RENAME an index (since phase 3, via the native class, in both lanes) and change Unique. (5) DELETE the entity: without force it is refused by the anonymous record and by the list type even without author consumers (tests/jobs-negative/delete-entity-in-use.json); with force it is an OBSERVED BEHAVIOR with unproven integrity: brokenConsumers 2 and orphans are left (IAttribute, IAnonymousStructure `DcScratch Record`, IListType `DcScratch List`) that Verify does not flag. None of this proves safe migration of a published database.
